rules.title: Server initializes over Streamable HTTP with spec 2025-11-25
'What can you do?' has an answer: server instructions describe the flow
rules.evidence: Hearth runs a short, warm daily check-in with a person who lives alone and keeps their family informed. person_id 0 mean…

rules.title: Every tool declares a valid JSON Schema inputSchema with required parameters present in properties
Tool descriptions are clear prose (40+ characters, no JSON)
Parameter descriptions include examples or synonyms
Every tool returned by tools/list is invocable (no dead or placeholder entries)
rules.evidence: invoked 14; failures: none; not exercised: none

rules.title: Tools return stable identifiers the next call can use
Round-trip under 500 ms per tool call (local measurement)
Unexpected parameters get a structured, actionable error (no stack trace, no internal ids)
rules.evidence: {"error": "unknown field shoe_size", "fields": {"mood": "1-5 how they feel", "sleep": "1-5 how they slept", "meds_taken": "yes/no", "ate": "

rules.title: Unknown record ids fail gracefully
Unknown person fails gracefully with a next step
A fresh start after a completed check-in creates a new record and keeps the old one
Answers can be updated independently (field-by-field record_answer)
Voice-only surfaces present at most 5 options at a time
Every _meta.ui.resourceUri resolves to a readable MCP App resource with the right mime type
Two-tier OAuth 2.1: 401 without a token, client_credentials service tier, PKCE user tier, refresh rotation, linked person
Plain-language description without API names, tool names or JSON
rules.evidence: Every morning Hearth has a short, warm conversation with the person: how they feel, how they slept, …

rules.title: Prerequisites stated (account linking)
rules.evidence: Account linking: the family sets up Hearth and links the device to the person it looks after.

rules.title: Privacy policy and terms of use URLs present and backed by files
Speakable, unambiguous add-on name
Icons in every required size, light and dark
At least 3 distinct example phrases
rules.evidence: Alexa, start my morning check-in; Alexa, how is Mom today?; Alexa, tell Hearth I have the dentist on Friday at ten
